evals.prompt: Generate a watercolor painting of a lighthouse at sunset using Gemini. Save it as lighthouse-gemini.png in the current directory.
evals.expected_output: A PNG image file at ./lighthouse-gemini.png generated via the Gemini provider script with correct flags
assertions: Used gemini.sh script from the plugin's scripts/ directory
Did NOT call Gemini API directly via curl or Python (used script instead)
PNG file successfully created at the output path
Output file is a valid PNG image with dimensions >= 512px on both axes
Agent did not require multiple failed attempts to discover the correct model name

evals.prompt: I need a hero image for my website - a dramatic mountain landscape with northern lights. Generate it with all three providers (Gemini, OpenAI, and xAI) so I can compare. Save them as hero-gemini.png, hero-openai.png, and hero-xai.png.
evals.expected_output: Three PNG images generated in parallel using all three provider scripts, with streaming display pane for progressive viewing
assertions: Used bundled provider scripts (gemini.sh, openai.sh, xai.sh) rather than raw API calls
Provider scripts were launched in parallel (not sequentially)
Used display_pane_open for streaming display OR SKIP_DISPLAY=1 with display_images after
All three output PNG files were successfully created
Correct naming convention used (hero-gemini.png, hero-openai.png, hero-xai.png)
All output files are valid PNGs with dimensions >= 512px on both axes
Total task completed in under 180 seconds

evals.prompt: I have a photo at ./test-input.png. Edit it to add a rainbow in the sky using OpenAI. Save the result as rainbow-edit.png.
evals.expected_output: An edited PNG image at ./rainbow-edit.png generated via the OpenAI provider script in edit mode with the input image
assertions: Used openai.sh script from the plugin's scripts/ directory
Output PNG file successfully created at the specified path
Output file is a valid PNG image with dimensions >= 512px on both axes
The input image (test-input.png) was referenced/passed in the command
Used the latest OpenAI image model (gpt-image-1.5, not gpt-image-1 or older)
